description: Header file defining the 'Generator' class in ATen, part of PyTorch's core for pseudo-random number generation, including thread safety notes, member functions for seed and state management, and utility functions.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A class representing a pseudo-random number generator in ATen, with methods for seed, state, device, and thread safety.

methods.name: set_current_seed
methods.description: Sets the current seed of the generator.

methods.name: set_offset
methods.description: Sets the offset of the generator state, supported for Philox-based generators.

methods.name: get_offset
methods.description: Returns the current offset of the generator state.

methods.name: current_seed
methods.description: Returns the current seed of the generator.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Returns the seed of the generator.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the generator's state from a tensor.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the generator's state as a tensor.

methods.name: graphsafe_set_state
methods.description: Sets the generator's state in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: graphsafe_get_state
methods.description: Gets the generator's state in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the generator.
